messages:
maria_support: customer escalated — after upgrading our Python SDK from 1.12.x -> 1.13.0 they started getting 401s. says nothing changed on their end. any idea?
jamie_eng: any quick repro? 1.13 had a small auth param rename, could be related. can you paste minimal code + pip freeze?
maria_support: pasted minimal snippet from customer:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="sk-XXXX")
resp = client.generate("hello")
```
customer says direct curl with `Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX` works, but SDK requests show 401 and captured header lacks `Bearer` prefix.
tyler_customer: pip show redwood-sdk -> Version: 1.13.0
tyler_customer: we also saw logs where header was `Authorization: sk-XXXX` (no Bearer) when sent by the SDK.
jamie_eng: ok that matches a regression i remember — default auth scheme got renamed internally from `Bearer` -> empty string in 1.13 when `auth_method` was introduced. If someone relies on the SDK to prefix `Bearer ` it can drop it if api_key present and a migration flag isn't set.
maria_support: customer asked for workaround until fix is released.
jamie_eng: workaround: pin to 1.12.4 or explicitly set scheme env var: `REDWOOD_AUTH_SCHEME=Bearer` or when constructing Client set `auth_scheme="Bearer"` (temporary API-surface accept in 1.13). run: `pip install 'redwood-sdk==1.12.4'`
tyler_customer: pinned to 1.12.4, reran tests — issue gone. thanks.
oncall_sre: tagging as rel-notes candidate and assigning to eng-runtime to triage regressions. @dev_alex can you pick up backport?
dev_alex: taking it. created branch `hotfix/auth-scheme-873` and opened PR #873, adding regen changelog and a test to assert Authorization includes `Bearer`. ETA ~2h for release cut. :thumbsup:
maria_support: i'll update the ticket with repro, workaround (pin + env var), and note upcoming 1.13.1. will move customer to case channel.
jamie_eng: internal note for release: add migration note in changelog and include a short code snippet for `REDWOOD_AUTH_SCHEME`. also double-check docs for `auth_method` rename.
tyler_customer: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
